policies.name: ptv_finance_kas_payments_read
policies.using:
((NOT is_finance_restricted_personnel()) AND (has_capability('finance.view'::text) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ptv_finance_kas_records r
  WHERE ((r.id = ptv_finance_kas_payments.record_id) AND ((r.ptv_id)::text = (current_authenticated_ptv_id())::text))))))

policies.name: ptv_finance_loan_payments_read
policies.using:
((NOT is_finance_restricted_personnel()) AND (has_capability('finance.manage'::text) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ptv_finance_loans l
  WHERE ((l.id = ptv_finance_loan_payments.loan_id) AND ((l.borrower_type)::text = 'kru'::text) AND ((l.borrower_id)::text = (current_authenticated_ptv_id())::text))))))

policies.name: inventory_authenticated_upload
policies.check: ((bucket_id = 'inventory'::text) AND ((has_capability('inventory.create'::text) IS TRUE) OR (has_capability('inventory.edit'::text) IS TRUE)))

policies.name: inventory_manager_delete
policies.using: ((bucket_id = 'inventory'::text) AND ((has_capability('inventory.delete'::text) IS TRUE) OR (has_capability('inventory.manage'::text) IS TRUE)))

policies.name: inventory_owner_cleanup
policies.using:
((bucket_id = 'inventory'::text) AND (owner = auth.uid()) AND (has_capability('inventory.create'::text) IS TRUE) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ptv_inventaris pi
  WHERE ((pi.foto_url IS NOT NULL) AND (pi.foto_url ~~ ('%'::text || objects.name)))))))

notes: All SQL explicitly wrapped in BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY and ROLLBACK.
No business RPCs invoked; no auth login/refresh/logout/email calls.
Definition fingerprints/ACLs are catalog evidence, not exploit or runtime tests.
Legacy not accessed. No real credentials/hashes/tokens or person rows exported.
Independent queries are not one global repeatable-read snapshot. Rebaseline under maintenance before migration.
